has the highest capacity. Only when there are two ore more who are of the
same generation do you have the choice to tap more than one (for whatever
reason you would want to do that...)

Brujah Debate [DS]
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Brujah
Cost: 1 pool
Master. Put this card in play. Each Methuselah with a ready Brujah must tap
[(one of)] the highest capacity Brujah he or she controls during his or her
master phase. Each Brujah gets +1 <strength> and an optional maneuver each
combat. This card may be burned by any minion who is not Ventrue as a (D)
action.

Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:
gray...@my-deja.com wrote:
> So, presuming there is no way to untap in your master phase, the only
> way to gain the benefit of multiple Brujah debates is to have multiple
> Brujah of the same ( highest ) capacity?

No. What he's saying is that no matter how many Brujah Debates you play,
you only have tap one Brujah.

Say you have 5 Brujah Debates in play and you have 4 Brujah (two 8 caps,
a 6 cap and a 4 cap) you tap one of the 8 cap vampires five times and
the other vampires (8 cap, 6 cap and 4 cap) are free to go about their
business as normal.

The same thing happens with Toreador Grand Ball. Multiple masters can
target the same vampire, barring specific card text.

Don't presume that. It will be wrong.

See the clarified online text here:

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Cardlist_B.html#Brujah_Debate

Brujah Debate [DS]
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Brujah
Cost: 1 pool
Master. Put this card in play. Each Methuselah with a ready Brujah must
tap [(one of)] the highest capacity Brujah he or she controls during
his or her master phase. Each Brujah gets +1 <strength> and an optional
maneuver each combat. This card may be burned by any minion who is not
Ventrue as a (D) action.

Notice that the card doesn't say the highest capacity Brujah
has to be untapped during your master phase for you to choose
them. If you had a high capacity Brujah tapped from Sensory
Deprivation, for example, you could choose that vampire for each
and every Brujah Debate you managed to put into play. (You could
also choose that same vampire every tapping it for a prior BD.)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
gray...@my-deja.com wrote:
> LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote:
> > Correct. You would generally tap the same Brujah X times.
> > Tapping a tapped vampire (like burning blood from an empty
> > vampire) has no effect.
>
> Ah, ok, I wan't aware that you can tap ( voluntarily or otherwise ) an
> already tapped vampire ( does that mean I have to rotate the card 90
> degrees again ? :)

You can't tap him - just as you can't burn blood from an empty
vampire. And, since Brujah Debate says to tap him, you get to
ignore that effect. If Brujah Debat said "tap him or burn this
Debate", then you wouldn't be able to ignore the effect and
would have to burn the Debate (having failed to tap him). If
it said "tap him to give each Brujah +1 strength and an optional
maneuver each combat until your next untap phase", then ignoring
the effect would result in no effect - no benefit for your Brujah.
